name: 한서윤
interests: public transit ridership and passenger flow prediction (smart-card / AFC data, station-level OD), crowding forecasting, graph and transformer models for transit networks
style: Korean 개조식, sentences end in '~함/~임'. content = problem → method → result in 4-6 short sentences, English technical terms kept as-is. memo = 1-2 lines, practical take (data availability, would it work for Seoul metro/bus).

name: 박지호
interests: last-mile delivery, truck-and-drone / robot delivery, learning-based vehicle routing (neural combinatorial optimization), crowdsourced delivery
style: Korean 서술형 prose ending in '~하였다/~이다', one paragraph. memo is critical and specific (toy instance sizes, unrealistic demand, missing baselines), sometimes trailing '…'.

name: Ana Costa
interests: urban air mobility operations, vertiport siting and scheduling, air traffic flow management, eVTOL demand and noise
style: English, structured template with headers 'Problem:', 'Proposed Method:', 'Validation:', 'Outcome:' each followed by '- ' bullet lines. memo = one short English sentence.

name: 최민재
interests: pedestrian behavior and trajectory prediction, crowd dynamics, pedestrian-vehicle interaction at crosswalks, socially-aware generative models
style: Korean-English mix 개조식 ('~함'), heavy English jargon. Often compares to other well-known models (e.g. 'Social-LSTM 대비', 'Trajectron++보다'). memo = what idea to borrow for own research.

name: 윤하늘
interests: shared micromobility (bike-sharing, e-scooters) demand and rebalancing, demand-responsive transit (DRT), mode choice and equity of new mobility services
style: Korean prose, concise (3-4 sentences). memo points out one key assumption that limits real-world use.

name: 강도윤
interests: railway operations: train delay prediction and propagation, disruption management, statistical and causal machine learning on operations logs
style: English prose, one dense paragraph, precise about data and evaluation (what is predicted, horizon, which railway). memo is rigorous and sometimes harsh.

name: 오세린
interests: transport network resilience and vulnerability, disaster evacuation, recovery after disruptions (floods, earthquakes), critical link identification
style: Korean, 'content' uses short '- ' bullet lines (배경/방법/결과). memo = 1-2 lines on scenario realism or data limitations.

name: 임태경
interests: LLM agents for activity and travel simulation, generative agents for urban mobility, LLM-based travel behavior modeling
style: Korean, shorter than others (new member), slightly casual ('~인 것 같음'). memo is enthusiastic or a question to follow up.

name: Lukas Becker
interests: signalized intersection performance measurement from connected-vehicle trajectory data, queue length and delay estimation, bicycle and pedestrian signal timing
style: English, terse: 3-5 '- ' bullet lines in content, no headers, no full paragraphs. memo is one blunt line (e.g. 'penetration rate assumption is optimistic').

name: Priya Raman
interests: human mobility modeling from GPS / mobile phone data, next-location and flow generation, POI visits, mobility foundation models
style: English prose, friendly and clear, 2 short paragraphs (what + why it matters). memo often links to another paper or asks a question to the lab.
